title: fix(service-storage)!: stored bytes outside the inline allow-list are served as attachments, with nosniff and a sandbox CSP
body: Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 用户在附件、文件下载里打开文件时：图片、PDF、纯文本照常在新标签页里直接预览；音视频会在浏览器的播放器里打开，用户按下播放后开始播放；其余类型（包括 SVG、HTML）改为下载到本地，不再在浏览器里直接打开。 - 这是文件存储加固：用一条规则决定哪些类型可以在浏览器里直接显示，本地存储和 S3 签名链接执行同一条规则。 - 如果有人依赖在浏览器里直接打开 SVG 或网页类附件，现在会变成下载；页面里用图片标签显示的 SVG 不受影响。可以整体撤回本改动。 - 要你做什么：本 PR 申报为收窄，契约审核 PASS 在案，需要授权账号批准当前 head。 ## What changes One rule for answering stored bytes, stated once in `packages/services/service-storage/src/served-bytes-policy.ts` and applied by every door that answers them: 1. **Inline only for the allow-list.** `INLINE_CONTENT_TYPES` holds raster images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, BMP), PDF, plain text, and common audio and video types. - Every other type, SVG and HTML included, is answered as an `attachment`. So is a missing or malformed type. - The type is judged by its essence: case is folded and parameters are dropped. A `charset` is kept on `text/plain` only. - A caller asking for `inline` never overrides the list. 2. **`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` on every answer** from the local byte route. 3. **A sandbox `Content-Security-Policy` on every answer** from the local byte route, which lets no script run. - Allow-listed audio and video answered inline carry `sandbox allow-same-origin; default-src 'none'; media-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'`, so the browser's player can load the file's own URL. - Every other answer carries `sandbox; default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'`. Doors held to the rule: | Door | Origin | What it does | |---|---|---| | `GET /api/v1/storage/_local/raw/:token` (local adapter) | the app's own | sets type (essence), disposition, `nosniff` and the CSP from the rule | | S3 adapter `getPresignedDownload` (behind `getSignedUrl`, `GET /files/:fileId`, `GET /files/:fileId/url` and the record-file read) | the bucket's | always bakes `ResponseContentType` (essence) and `ResponseContentDisposition`; a signed `GetObject` URL can carry no other response header, so `nosniff` and the CSP are the bucket's to send | `GET /files/:fileId` and `GET /files/:fileId/url` serve no bytes of their own; both mint through `mintDownloadUrl`. Docs and contract text: - `content/docs/permissions/attachments-access.mdx` gains a "How a downloaded file is answered" section, which tells a host that fronts its bucket on the app's own origin to send the two headers at its proxy. - The TSDoc of `PresignedDownloadOptions.disposition` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/storage-service.ts`) now says `inline` is a request the allow-list decides. The change is description-only. Not in this PR: holding a declared type to its bytes. The maintainer ruled it a separate serve-time follow-up. ## Tests - `packages/services/service-storage/src/served-bytes-policy.test.ts`: the allow-list table, essence parsing, the local raw route's headers (both CSP variants as literals), and the S3 signed URL's baked parameters. - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/stored-bytes-served-disposition.dogfood.test.ts`: a real boot with the local adapter. It covers presign, byte PUT, commit, the download door's signed link, and the raw route's answer. - `ui/e2e/live/stored-bytes-inline-allow-list.spec.ts`, in the required Live E2E lane: a browser reads a PNG that renders, a text file that renders, and a WAV that loads in the player, and an HTML file arrives as a download. - Controls: an ordinary PNG and PDF still preview inline. - Every rule pin is red on the base and green on the head. Each guard was ablated and restored. ## Acceptance notes - Measured in Chromium only; Firefox and Safari were not measured. - Under the media policy the player does not start playback on its own; it starts when the user presses play. - An `` that shows a stored SVG keeps showing it: an image element ignores the disposition. ## Verification - CI on the head: every required check is green, including the Live E2E lane with the new spec. - Contract review: PASS on the head (security seat). 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_017xRBcW9L8Noz9BxEwjwiov
